dedupeText: retro pop rock album layout 1980s white suit electric guitar prohibition sign pop rock halftone texture italic sans serif subject positioned off center left to balance the graphic sign on the right high contrast between the black guitar tie and the white suit background repetition of the guitar silhouette in the prohibition sign diagonal tension created by the guitar neck and the sign s slash combine high key studio photography of a musician in formal wear with bold italicized swiss style typography and a conceptual graphic icon to create a classic 80s pop rock aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male musician in a white suit holding a black electric guitar, set against a stark white background with a graphic 'No Fun' prohibition sign on the right and bold italicized typography at the top left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left to balance the graphic sign on the right
High contrast between the black guitar/tie and the white suit/background
Repetition of the guitar silhouette in the prohibition sign
Diagonal tension created by the guitar neck and the sign's slash
coreInvariants: White studio background with subtle magenta/cyan halftone noise in lower half
Musician wearing a white blazer over a white shirt with a dark red tie
A rectangular white sign with a red circle-slash over a guitar silhouette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, waist-up view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black electric guitar held horizontally across the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold name top left, moves down to the subject's face, follows the guitar neck to the right, and ends on the prohibition sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the upper center and around the graphic sign to prevent clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and suit) providing a clean, high-key foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (guitar, hair, text) for structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (tie, prohibition circle) to draw attention to key conceptual elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value overall with punchy, saturated red accents and deep black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Strict white, black, and red primary palette with natural skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Strong italicization (oblique) for the main name
Uniform stroke weight in the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Underline extending from the base of the first word to the end of the second word in the display name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Italicized extended sans-serif for the artist name paired with a standard upright geometric sans-serif for the conceptual sign.
graphicDevices: Prohibition sign (red circle with 45-degree diagonal slash)
Subtle CMYK halftone pattern overlay on the lower half of the image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and clean geometric feel of the primary text.
Appropriate for the geometric all-caps text inside the sign.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man with 80s feathered hair in a white suit and red tie holding a black electric guitar against a white wall. Include a white rectangular sign on the right wall with a red 'no' symbol over a guitar icon. Apply a subtle magenta/cyan halftone screen effect to the bottom half.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the top left using a heavy, italicized black sans-serif font with a thin underline. Add the title text inside the sign on the right in a bold, all-caps black geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the name text italicized and bold?
Is the red tie the only significant splash of color on the subject?
Does the sign on the right feature a red circle-slash?
Is there a halftone texture visible in the lower portion?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the red tie
Angle of the guitar being held
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician
Exact guitar brand logos or headstock shapes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the white background.
Check that the red in the tie matches the red in the sign.
Verify the halftone effect doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the guitar neck points toward the sign.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-key studio photography of a musician in formal wear with bold, italicized Swiss-style typography and a conceptual graphic icon to create a classic 80s pop-rock aesthetic.
